critical.issue: 422 ValidationException is INCORRECTLY logged as 'Kegagalan sistem' with status_code=500. Root cause: the match() block classifies exceptions as 403 (AuthorizationException/UnauthorizedException), else HttpExceptionInterface->getStatusCode(), else default=>500. Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException does NOT implement HttpExceptionInterface (it has a public ->status property set to 422) so it falls through to default=>500 and gets recorded as a system failure. Reproducer: POST /users with empty body returns 422 but adds a row with action='Kegagalan sistem', status_code=500, context.pengecualian='ValidationException'. Expected: 422 should NOT create any audit row (per spec: 'kesalahan validasi (422) ... TIDAK boleh membuat entri audit').

action_items: Fix bootstrap/app.php match() to explicitly handle ValidationException: add `$e instanceof \Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException => $e->status,` (or return null before match) so 422 exits early and is NOT recorded. After the fix, TestIteration14AuditNoiseAndSystemFailure::test_422_does_not_create_audit_row must pass.
critical_code_review_comments: bootstrap/app.php: the default => 500 fallback swallows every non-Http exception (ValidationException, AuthenticationException, TokenMismatchException, ThrottleRequestsException…) and mislabels them as 500. Handle each 4xx sibling explicitly (ValidationException=>422, AuthenticationException=>401, ThrottleRequestsException=>429) OR use `method_exists($e,'getStatusCode') ? $e->getStatusCode() : ($e->status ?? 500)` before applying the 403/>=500 filter.

rca_of_the_issue: In bootstrap/app.php the render() closure computes $status via a match() with only 3 arms: AuthorizationException/UnauthorizedException => 403, HttpExceptionInterface => getStatusCode(), default => 500. Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException extends \Exception (not HttpException) and exposes ->status=422. Because it hits the default arm, $status=500 which passes the '>=500' filter and gets recorded as 'Kegagalan sistem' with status_code=500. NotFoundHttpException works correctly because it IS a Symfony HttpException with getStatusCode()=404 → filtered out. Fix: add ValidationException handling to the match or short-circuit early: `if ($e instanceof \Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException) return null;`.
